exchanges.prompt: C3 actual development prompt: Make approval create an immutable per-case snapshot bound to a revision. Any later draft or recipient edit must clear approval/export/return readiness and send the case back to specialist review. Export must use only the snapshot; missing-note or assistant actions must never approve via programmatic calls. Add clear stage-specific next-owner text and local event trail. Intended learning: can staff identify the correct next step and avoid returning an unreviewed revision? Log exact prompt/result and use meaningful API checks.
exchanges.purpose: Prevent an edited revision or changed recipient from inheriting an earlier approval; clarify ownership and audit sequence.
exchanges.result: Approval now freezes an internal per-case snapshot containing text, recipient, practice, revision, approver and time. Specialist edits to a draft or recipient from review, ready or returned increment revision and clear approval, export and simulated-return flags. Export reads only the snapshot. Added specialist recipient editing, explicit stage-specific next-owner guidance, and local events. Missing-source and role guards apply inside the API.
exchanges.validation: 61 Node VM assertions passed for missing-note cases, role denials, prepare/review/approval/export/return, immutable returned state copies, snapshot-only export, post-return draft invalidation, recipient-change invalidation and reset.
